nom: Banila Co Clean It Zero Kiwi Kale Pore Pack Cleanser

avis.texte: Been using this brand for years now. Love this particular formula just as much as their jar formula for pore clarifying. Not too gritty, creamy lather. Doesn't strip my skin or make it feel unclean. Smell is more kale than kiwi but not unpleasant. Rinses easily.
